message: I love you and I really want to be with you
As long as I feel that you too want to put in that time and effort for us, I will never give up on us, I promise.

*I will*.
I have never been loved so deeply by another human being. I could go on in the search of a better person, but then I would be dis-respecting this love that we have for each other. And what kind of a lover would I be then ?
